title: Cement Board / Tile Backer
short_answer: Cement board is not drywall with a different color.
summary: Cement board is not drywall with a different color.
plain_words: Cement board is not drywall with a different color. You do not mud it like gypsum, you do not hang it on a bounce-y wall, and you do not guess who owns the waterproofing membrane. Wrong here is tear-out behind tile.
when_to_use: When the job calls for cement board / tile backer
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.title: Confirm the product
steps.body: cement board / glass-mat tile backer vs moisture-resistant gypsum. Tile usually wants backer; paint often wants MR gypsum. The finish schedule decides.

steps.title: Check framing deflection for tile (often L/360). If the wall is soft, stop
steps.body: tiling over flex is a callback.

steps.title: Fasten per the manufacturer
steps.body: pattern, screw type, and edge distances. Do not "drywall screw it wherever."

steps.title: Joints: treat with the listed alkali-resistant mesh / base as required
steps.body: not ordinary paper tape and all-purpose mud as if it were a bedroom wall.

steps.title: Transitions to drywall are deliberate
steps.body: height, bead, and who finishes what.

steps.title: Waterproofing membrane is often another trade
steps.body: If ownership is unclear, stop and get it in writing before you cover the substrate.
